{"consolidated_memory":"**Multiple off-by-one day incidents in ui/components/DatePicker.tsx**

All three incidents share the same symptom (selected value one day behind the label) triggered by the same repro step (pick the first of the month and reopen), but have entirely different root causes and fixes:

**Incident 1: [2026-02-13] Transaction isolation failure (v1 SDK clients)**
- Affected: clients pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #2428 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-1
- Outcome: error rate dropped from 5.3% to under 0.7% (7 per 10,000)

**Incident 2: [2026-03-25] Missing database index causing race condition**
- Affected: when two requests raced on the same key
- Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: added the composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR #3512 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-2
- Outcome: memory settled at 739 MB instead of climbing past 8 GB

**Incident 3: [2026-06-14] Clock skew in 5% rollout bucket**
- Affected: accounts in the 5% rollout bucket
- Root cause: clock skew between two hosts
- Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #6917 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-3
- Outcome: backlog cleared 76 minutes after the deploy

All work occurred in the same corner of ui/components/DatePicker.tsx; context carried over from earlier off-by-one day work in this component."}
